description: This Java class extends akka.persistence.AbstractPersistentActorWithTimers to add cleanup functionality, handling commands to delete snapshots and persisted messages up to the latest snapshot sequence number. It manages cleanup responses, tracks cleanup state, and logs key events. The filename suggests it is an abstract base class for persistent actors with cleanup features.

classes.name: AbstractPersistentActorWithTimersAndCleanup
classes.description: An abstract class extending Akka's AbstractPersistentActorWithTimers, providing additional handling for cleanup commands by deleting snapshots and events up to a specified sequence number. It manages cleanup responses, coordinates cleanup process, and logs activities.

methods.name: getLatestSnapshotSequenceNumber
methods.description: Abstract method intended to return the sequence number of the latest persisted snapshot.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Sets up message handlers for cleanup commands, responses for snapshot and message deletions.

methods.name: staleEventsKeptAfterCleanup
methods.description: Returns the number of events to retain after cleanup; defaults to zero.

methods.name: handleCleanupCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming cleanup commands, initiates cleanup if applicable, or rejects if a cleanup is already in progress.

methods.name: handleDeleteSnapshotsResponse
methods.description: Handles responses for snapshot deletion, storing response state.

methods.name: handleDeleteMessagesResponse
methods.description: Handles responses for message deletion, storing response state.

methods.name: checkCleanupCompleted
methods.description: Checks if cleanup responses indicate success or failure, logs, and sends result back to origin.

methods.name: isCleanupCompletedSuccessfully
methods.description: Determines if both snapshot and message deletions succeeded.

methods.name: getResponseStatus
methods.description: Generates a string describing the status of delete responses, including failure causes.

methods.name: startCleanup
methods.description: Begins cleanup by deleting snapshots and messages up to calculated sequence numbers based on latest snapshot number.

methods.name: finishCleanup
methods.description: Resets cleanup state variables after cleanup completes.
